claim: Every daily puzzle is solver-checked below the 40-move limit.
sandbox: Generate 42 consecutive UTC seeds across seven full rule cycles; solve each through the production transition function and assert its verified length is below 40.

claim: The same UTC date recreates the same board and rule card.
sandbox: Generate the same dated puzzle twice from clean state and compare the complete puzzle definitions.

claim: A sample run can be played through to a win screen.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; use only visible courier and arrow controls for every remaining solver move; assert the focused win dialog and save a screenshot.

claim: Restart puzzle restores all courier positions and the move count.
sandbox: Fresh /demo run played to the win screen; press Restart puzzle and assert move zero plus all three original courier locations.

claim: A run that reaches 40 accepted moves ends on a loss screen.
sandbox: Fresh /demo run; make 32 valid visible moves after the eight sample moves and assert the real loss dialog at move 40.

claim: The game supports keyboard arrows, swipe, and on-screen direction controls.
sandbox: Fresh /demo run; execute one solver move by keyboard, one by pointer swipe, and one with an on-screen direction button; assert each state change.

claim: Sound and reduced-motion settings stay set after reload.
sandbox: Enter settings from /demo, change both controls, reload, and assert the saved states in the isolated demo namespace.

claim: Sample play never changes saved daily progress.
sandbox: Place sentinel daily data in localStorage, use and reset /demo, then assert both real keys remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

claim: Play is free without an account, and game progress stays in this browser.
where: landing facts, privacy page, terms page, README
sandbox: Record all requests during sample play, assert only the product origin is contacted, and assert the changed game is present in localStorage.

claim: The game reloads offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Use a dedicated fresh browser context, load /demo until its service worker controls the page, go offline, reload, and operate the rule example.

claim: The board loop stays above 50 fps in the mobile browser test with four-times CPU slowdown.
sandbox: Fresh 390×844 mobile context with Chromium CPU throttled 4×; measure the production requestAnimationFrame loop for two seconds and require at least 50 fps.
